name: Inwardcurve Onslaught
description: Bring the belly down on the crest of a helm so the force rolls through the skull cap.

name: Needling Gash
description: Hack at the narrow gap between helm and shoulder plate where the armor lies thin.

name: Chime Kinkspine
description: Slide the blade along the edge of a plate-armored arm to let a strike skid off.

name: Might Forwardbelly
description: Shuffle forward under heavy armor swings with the belly held high and ready.

name: Waistlinctus
description: Read the rivet lines on an armored opponent to find where the plates overlap thinnest.

name: Gashtorment
description: Drive the heel of the edge into a plate seam with qi packed behind it to split the joint.

name: Scalding Heavytip
description: Chop again onto the exact dent of the first blow to force the plate through.

name: Cho Greave
description: Hook the belly behind a plated elbow and drag to pull the heavy arm out of its guard.

name: Rumble Bulgeedge
description: Gather qi in the belly through a count of breaths and hew down to split a breastplate at the sternum.

name: Ironkink
description: Cross two qi-driven cuts at a plate joint and peel the metal away from the flesh beneath.

name: Rumble Pommelcap
description: Let the qi field hold the blade at the top of a swing and release it in a long hew.

name: Chohauberk
description: Thicken the field beside the spine of the blade to meet a strike without a bruise to the wrist.

name: Gust Notch
description: Skim forward over rough ground while the qi field smooths each footfall.

name: Hookbelly Remedy
description: Feel the opposing qi field against the blade and read how much force it holds in reserve.

name: Sanguine Horntang
description: Hold a steady pour of qi through the blade and hack in a long unbroken rhythm of alternating strokes.

name: Iron Chip
description: Let the field push the blade back off a parry and return it across the opponent in a backcut.

name: Cleaving Chopmass
description: Keep up cut after cut with steady qi until the opponent has no space to step or strike.

name: Rumble Horntang
description: Burst the stored field into the edge in one chop that crushes a shield rim where it lands.

name: Mayhemwhump
description: Spin the blade in a wheel with the field behind it and drive back every foe near the user.

name: Rumblenotch
description: Seat the notch on a descending blade and chop the opponent's wrist as it sinks.

name: Gust Heavytip
description: Lift an incoming blade in the notch and carry it high over the opponent's own head.

name: Gashpounce
description: Slip a half pace aside as the notch takes the blow so the strike runs off the body.

name: Toxinwaist
description: Jam the handle against an opponent's cross-guard to stall their next stroke.

name: Waningwaist
description: Read the tremor in a caught blade to learn when the opponent intends to tear free.

name: Chocloak
description: Take a heavy blow in the notch and send the same weight back along the blade line.

name: Staggering Lopstroke
description: Set the notch into a caught edge and flow qi through it to hold the blade rigid.

name: Waistcuirass
description: Wrench the caught blade round in a half circle until the opponent stumbles after it.

name: Might Whump
description: Release the notch and chop at once into the opponent's recovering forearm.

name: Facet Chip
description: Wedge a qi-hardened notch into a thick blade and snap the weapon across its weak point.

name: Annealed Kinkspine
description: Catch a strong strike in the notch and turn it into a hard chop against the striker's own guard.

name: Might Chopmass
description: Take the blade out wide and bring the full curve around in a long swing at the flank.

name: Hoarfrost Bulgeedge
description: Carry the blade in a round arc over the head to cover against a falling blow.

name: Torrent Inwardcurve
description: Walk the feet in a small circle that follows the line of the swinging blade.

name: Veritywaist
description: Feel the tip of the curved blade pass through air and note any resistance from nearby foes.

name: Gust Pommelcap
description: Bend the swing with qi so the belly curves around a raised guard and lands behind it.

name: Mayhem Hookbelly
description: Hook a passing blade in the swing of the curve and drag it out and away from the target.

name: Gash Assault
description: Reap in a single qi-driven sweep that follows the whole curve and scythes through a line of foes.

name: Sanguine Slash
description: Draw one swing inside another with a gathered breath so the final cut meets the target twice.

name: Rumblechip
description: Close both kukri from opposite sides at once and meet the target in the middle.

name: Charter Bulgeedge
description: Cross both spines over the head to take a heavy strike on the joined steel.

name: Cho Canter
description: Step forward with each blade as the foot beside it lands so the pair keeps one rhythm.

name: Iron Notch
description: Roll the wrists in mirrored circles so one blade always follows the other.

name: Thornwaist
description: Hook the opponent's lead arm with the off-hand blade while the main hand readies a chop.

name: Verity Forwardbelly
description: Feel the gap between the two curves and use it to read how near the opponent stands.

name: Gust Slash
description: Drive two chops along parallel qi tracks so both land in the same breath on different limbs.

name: Hoarfrost Horntang
description: Pinch an opponent's wrist between the two notches and pin it with qi in both blades.

name: Lancing Whump
description: Alternate strokes from left and right blade like rolling water until the target gives ground.

name: Murk Inwardcurve
description: Throw a strike aside with one blade and cut across the opening with the other.

name: Skinning Gash
description: Gather matched qi in both blades and bring them down together in a single hew that cannot be parried.

name: Blaze Kinkspine
description: Cross both blades through a wide sweep so two tracks of qi clear the ground around the user.

name: Granite Chip
description: Hold the blade high and fall onto the target with the whole body in a diving chop.

name: Chime Forwardbelly
description: Spread both arms like a flaring wing and sweep the blade across to scatter a blow.

name: Blaze Lopstroke
description: Hook up under the guard from below with the tip curled like a claw.

name: Hastening Cho
description: Perch still on one foot then pounce a full pace with the blade already falling.

name: Remnant Pommelcap
description: Hold the blade high and read the whole field of the fight from that raised guard.

name: Tearing Notch
description: Let qi fall down the leg and arm together so the diving chop arrives at doubled speed.

name: Gyve Chopmass
description: Hook the belly under a weapon like a claw and pull it out of the opponent's grip.

name: Gust Whump
description: Hop up and back on a burst of qi and land out of reach with the blade raised.

name: Cleaving Hookbelly
description: Gather qi through a held breath above the head and fall in one chop that shakes the ground.

name: Grinding Horntang
description: Circle the foe with stooping feints until the opponent dares not lift a guard to either side.

name: Might Lopstroke
description: Follow the bend of the curve through a swing that turns in the middle and lands at the side.

name: Kinkplating
description: Turn the spine in a small eddy against a strike and let it spin harmlessly past.

name: Slash Sprint
description: Step along the line of the opponent's flank as water runs along a bank.

name: Forwardbelly Remedy
description: Feel which way the opponent's weight flows through the blade contact and go with it.

name: Rumblewaist
description: Wind qi through the curve so the edge passes round a guard in a smooth falling cut.

name: Rumble Heavytip
description: Draw the hooked blade back under the foe's weapon like an undertow and unbalance them.

name: Gyve Bulgeedge
description: Spiral the blade around a caught weapon in tightening circles until it is wound into a lock.

name: Rumblecho
description: Surge a flood of stored qi through the bend of the curve into one overwhelming chop.

name: Dismantling Chopmass
description: Spread a fan of cuts outward from the point of the blade like a river splitting at its mouth.

name: Sanguine Notch
description: Plant both feet on level ground and bring the blade straight down in a hew that wastes nothing.

name: Granite Hookbelly
description: Chop with the heel of the edge into the first thing that crosses open ground.

name: Thornkink
description: Take the oath stance with the spine across the body and meet a hard blow without moving.

name: Silt Heavytip
description: Turn to face the wind and step into the attack so no part of the body is exposed.

name: Rumble Gash
description: Shove the handle butt into the opponent's shoulder to rock them back on their heels.

name: Choremedy
description: Read the direction of the wind by its touch on the edge and plan each cut with it.

name: Iron Cho
description: Settle qi into the stance and chop with the settled weight as though the whole plateau stood behind it.

name: Harpooning Slash
description: Carry a backhand in on a gust of qi that makes the blade hard to follow with the eye.

name: Facetkink
description: Hold the oath stance with a steady pour of qi and let strikes break against it.

name: Unmaking Pommelcap
description: Gather qi from the ground through the stance and release it all in one hew that no parry can stop.

name: Blaze Inwardcurve
description: Cut a long flat arc at waist height that sweeps the open ground clear of attackers.

name: Skinning Whump
description: Sight along the spine on a fixed bearing and chop down the exact line.

name: Kinktorment
description: Turn the body a quarter on the held bearing and return the blade in a backcut.

name: Vaulting Lopstroke
description: Shift a pace along the bearing line and keep the front foot pointed at the foe.

name: Unshaken Pommelcap
description: Hold the blade along the bearing line and let a strike slide off its length.

name: Verity Kinkspine
description: Mark the foe's position against the wind and update the bearing with every breath.

name: Granite Slash
description: Lock qi onto the fixed bearing so the hew keeps its line even through a dodge.

name: Blazegash
description: Cut along two bearings in a single motion so the opponent faces two lines at once.

name: Kinkcanter
description: Correct the bearing mid-step with a burst of qi and arrive on the opponent's blind side.

name: Splitting Chip
description: Hold a long bearing through a drawn breath and release the blade along it in a piercing chop.

name: Mayhem Heavytip
description: Cut a web of crossing bearings around the foe until they cannot tell which line is real.

name: Trouncing Notch
description: Draw on the out-breath and let the slash leave the sheath in time with it.

name: Murk Horntang
description: Use the opening of the sheath mouth to knock a thrust aside as the blade is pulled.

name: Blurring Whump
description: Enter on a gust of breath with the whole body already moving into the draw.

name: Remnant Cho
description: Rest the hand on the handle and read the foe's own preparation to draw.

name: Slashtorment
description: Ride a second breath of qi into a returning cut that follows the first before it lands.

name: Hastening Bulgeedge
description: Cut through a barrier with the draw and stride through the gap before it closes.

name: Harrowing Granite Gash
description: Release a qi-charged draw so fast that the cut lands before the hand is seen to move.

name: Transfixing Chip
description: Return the blade to the sheath on a held breath and loose it again in a single chop.
